_comment: FROZEN, HAND-AUTHORED battery. Install it with `criteria_file:` on the task so no job
synthesizes its own — two jobs that author their own graders are not comparable.
Rules every criterion here follows, each one a defect this pack has actually shipped:
* The exit-code guard is at the TOP LEVEL of the expression, never inside a lambda
whose ARGUMENT does the parsing. Python evaluates a call's arguments before its
body, so `(lambda d: exit_code == 0 and ...)(json.loads(stdout))` parses BEFORE it
checks the exit code, raises on the base tree, and scores the criterion `None`.
* No piped commands. The shell reports the LAST stage's status, so a pipe makes
* No `__import__`. `re` and `json` are already bound in the battery sandbox.
* `pytest` is invoked WITHOUT `-q`: pytest.ini already sets it, and a second one
suppresses the summary line and the node-id listing these criteria parse.
* Test-suite size is counted from COLLECTED NODE IDS, never by grepping file text
for a word. The fixture contains the string `assets.cashflow` inside an unrelated
assertion, so a text grep for 'cashflow' is satisfied by the pristine tree.
* 156 is the fixture's own test count at pinned SHA 6f1f1f73, pinned by
tests/test_task_packs.py so a fixture change fails CI instead of drifting.

criteria.description: The full test suite passes with no failures and no errors.
No pre-existing test was removed: at least 156 tests are still collected.
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and len([l for l in stdout.splitlines() if '::' in l]) >= 156

criteria.description: Tests were ADDED for the new report: more than the 156 collected before the change. This is what the work order asks for and what the acceptance text used to omit; it cannot check that the added test is meaningful.
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and len([l for l in stdout.splitlines() if '::' in l]) > 156

criteria.description: The cashflow report over 2024-Q4 exits 0 and its columns are exactly month, currency, inflow, outflow, net in that order.
meta.months for that report is exactly the three Q4 labels, and every row's month field is one of them.
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and json.loads(stdout)['meta']['months'] == ['2024-10', '2024-11', '2024-12'] and all(row[0] in ['2024-10', '2024-11', '2024-12'] for row in json.loads(stdout)['rows'])

criteria.description: Over all dates, the net column across USD rows sums to the ledger's own USD balance for assets.cash (47233.75).
criteria.pass_condition: exit_code == 0 and abs(sum(float(row[4]) for row in json.loads(stdout)['rows'] if row[1] == 'USD') - 47233.75) < 0.005

criteria.description: --account narrows the cash subtree: meta.root reflects the narrower account.
criteria.command: python3 -m ledgerline.cli report cashflow tests/data/sample.ledger --account assets.cash.checking --json
